comment: Heavy Sweeper and Turret demonstration on the test range. FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/test/heavy-turret-range.json, FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/heavy-turret.json. Ordinary movement, aim, trigger and reload; no granted equipment or teleports. Each fight observes the first enemy shot and strafes during committed tells.

states.name: range_supplies
states.note: Collect the Scatter, the Flechette and bullets before the lane.

states.name: range_armed
states.note: Select the Flechette for both fights.

states.name: turret_idle
states.note: Dormant turret down the lane, eleven metres away, before its group wakes.

states.name: turret_fight
states.note: The head tracks, the coils charge, the locked rail shot fires. Strafe during the charge, then return fire.

states.name: bypass_health
states.note: The bypass behind the lane wall: the turret flank route, with a medkit.

states.name: heavy_idle
states.note: Dormant Heavy Sweeper across the yard, twelve metres away.

states.name: heavy_fight
states.note: Pauldrons flare and lamps light before the four-round burst. Strafe, then commit ammunition.
